question: A soap workshop poured 56 moulds, and each mould set into 6 bars. A gift shop bought 218 bars for its Christmas stock. A returned order brought 58 bars back to the workshop, and a new batch added 64 more. A hotel then took 226 bars for its rooms. The workshop has been making soap for a dozen years. How many bars are left?

On Wednesday morning Tomas had 107 boxes of nails in his van and left 53 of them at the first site. Before lunch he dropped 21 more boxes at a second site. In the afternoon his colleague Freya, who carries fewer boxes than Tomas, loaded 57 boxes into his van from the depot. That evening he checked and confirmed that every box in the van holds 8 packets. How many packets of nails are in the van?

A shop had 31 gift boxes on the shelf and sold 28 of them before the holiday. Then 2 more were taken for the window display. Every box still on the shelf contains 7 candles. A supplier delivered 54 loose candles to the same shelf. The shop has been open for a dozen years and lists its opening times in minutes past the hour rather than in hours. How many candles are on the shelf?

On Monday morning Ilse counted 237 pallets in the warehouse, and a delivery added 22 more before lunch. Every pallet carries 4 crates. In the afternoon her colleague Ben, who had handled fewer pallets than Ilse, added 48 loose crates from his own bay. Each crate holds 9 boxes, and every box is packed with 2 sleeves. In the evening the team confirmed that each sleeve contains 9 sachets. How many sachets are in the warehouse?

Marisol filled 53 boxes, and each box held 9 packets of dried apricots. Every packet contains 3 handfuls. A supplier added 41 loose handfuls to the store. A wholesaler bought 1036 handfuls, and her partner Ivo, who packed fewer boxes than Marisol, took another 241 handfuls for his own shop. Each handful that remains is repacked into 8 small bags. The pair have worked together for a dozen years. How many small bags does the repacking produce?

A craft supplier had 32 boxes of beads in the stockroom, and a second delivery raised the count to 2 times that number. A returned order then added 42 more boxes to the same shelf. Every box holds 7 bags of beads, and a courier brought 71 loose bags to go with them. Each bag contains 7 beads. The stockroom is 25 metres long, and the supplier quotes its dispatch times in minutes rather than hours. How many beads are in the stockroom?

On Thursday morning a bakery split 201 sacks of flour equally between its 3 kitchens. Before lunch a mill delivered 12 more sacks to the first kitchen. Every sack in that kitchen makes 9 loaves. In the evening a partner bakery sent 55 finished loaves across to the same kitchen. How many loaves does the first kitchen have?

A camp had 109 packets of soup and used 99 of them during the first week. Every packet still in the cupboard makes 8 bowls. A parent donated 38 ready-made bowls of soup for the weekend. The hikers ate 74 bowls on Saturday. A late delivery added 3 more bowls that evening. The camp sleeps 60 people. How many bowls of soup are there now?

A cinema had 155 boxes of popcorn ready on Friday morning and sold 52 of them before noon. At lunchtime a delivery added 50 boxes to the counter. During the afternoon the kitchen made another 16, and in the early evening a supplier sent 36 more. Every box on the counter is filled from 4 scoops of popcorn. The cinema lists its film lengths in minutes rather than hours. How many scoops are needed for the boxes on the counter?

A print shop bound 141 folders, and each folder holds 9 booklets. Every booklet contains 6 pages. The pages were then shared equally between 6 archive boxes, and the first archive box took one share. That box's pages were later split equally between 3 shelves, with the top shelf taking the first part. The counter is 4 metres long, the shop has been open for a dozen years, and it quotes its jobs in minutes rather than hours. How many pages are on the top shelf?

On Sunday morning a hostel had 62 clean sheets and sent 14 of them away to be mended. The rest were divided equally between 2 floors. During the afternoon the laundry delivered 40 sheets to the ground floor. In the early evening a hotel lent that floor 17 more. Later that night 4 of the ground floor's sheets were ruined by a leaking radiator. How many sheets does the ground floor have?

Yasmin bottled 206 litres of apple juice on each of 3 days. A supermarket order then took 297 litres from the store. Her partner Callum, who bottled far less than Yasmin, took another 213 litres for his own shop. A school fete bought 97 litres after that. The pair have pressed apples together for a dozen years. How many litres are left in the store?

On Monday morning a factory had 225 reels of thread and used 199 of them on a big order. Every reel still in the store holds 8 spools. During the afternoon a supplier delivered 53 loose spools of the same kind. In the evening the staff worked out that each spool carries 5 metres of thread. A repair job then used 715 metres from the store. How many metres of thread are left?

A gardener had 16 packets of bulbs and planted 12 of them along the path. Then 2 packets were spoiled when the shed flooded. Every packet still dry holds 7 bulbs. A neighbour gave her 48 loose bulbs, and the garden centre added 7 more. Squirrels then dug up and destroyed 14 bulbs. The path itself is 22 metres long. How many bulbs does the gardener have?

A running club's charity fund stood at 210 pounds at the start of the month. A bake sale added 39 pounds and a car wash brought in 23. A member's sponsored run raised 43 pounds, and a quiz night added 40 more. A local firm then donated 78 pounds to the same fund. A collection tin in the clubhouse held a final 10 pounds. The club has a dozen junior members and 85 seniors. How many pounds are in the fund now?

A bookbinder had 221 reams in the store and bought 64 more at auction. A college order then used up 77 reams. Every ream still in the store is cut into 8 blocks. Each block is folded into 3 signatures, and every signature carries 5 printed pages. The bindery has worked on this street for a dozen years. How many printed pages could the store's paper make?

A kennel had 92 bags of dog food in the store. A busy boarding week used 70 of them. Then 10 bags went to the rescue centre down the road. A mouse spoiled 5 more bags, and 3 were given to a volunteer for her own dogs. A supplier delivered 3 replacement bags that afternoon. The kennel has room for 24 dogs and writes its feeding times in minutes rather than hours. How many bags of dog food are in the store?

A choir had 72 music folders and sent 16 of them away to be rebound. Half of the folders that remained went to the tenors and half to the basses. The tenors were then given 23 more folders by a retiring member. A neighbouring choir lent them another 19, and the librarian found 11 in the vestry cupboard. How many folders do the tenors have now?

A packing plant had 141 pallets and a lorry delivered 50 more. Every pallet carries 9 cases. Each case holds 4 cartons, and every carton contains 6 sachets. A courier then dropped off 8 loose sachets at the office. The plant has been running for a dozen years. How many sachets are at the plant?

Sofia had 37 jars of chutney on her stall and her mother brought 49 more from the kitchen. A neighbour added 27 jars of his own to the same table. Then 2 jars were knocked off and broken. Every jar on the table holds 8 spoonfuls of chutney. Her friend Marta, who had made fewer jars than Sofia, prepared twice as many spoonfuls as were on Sofia's table for the village hall tasting. How many spoonfuls did Marta prepare?

Nadia records her golf practice in minutes rather than in hours, because her coach prefers it that way. On Monday morning her logbook showed 171 minutes for the week. During the afternoon she added 29 minutes on the driving range, and in the evening she added another 40 minutes of putting practice. Her coach then found that 174 of the logged minutes belonged to an earlier week and struck them off. The minutes that were left were divided equally between 2 report cards, one for the club and one for her school. How many minutes were written on one report card?

Marcus assembles 75 badges every hour at the workshop, and last Friday he worked for 9 hours straight. He packed the whole day's output into 3 identical crates, with the same number of badges in each crate. Dana, who runs the sister workshop, ordered 6 crates of exactly that size for a conference. The two of them joked that Dana's single order was larger than anything Marcus had ever built in a day. Sadly, 254 badges in Dana's order came out with the wrong logo and were thrown away. The workshop has been open for 12 years. How many usable badges were in Dana's order?

Aisha's nursery started the season with 138 seedling trays, but a late frost ruined 36 of them. Every remaining tray was planted with 6 tomato seedlings. A neighbouring farm donated 74 extra seedlings, and later that month 302 seedlings were sold at the market. The greenhouse is 45 metres long, and the staff always record their watering times in minutes rather than in hours. Each seedling Aisha still has is expected to produce 9 tomatoes. How many tomatoes should the nursery expect from its seedlings?

Each morning the Larkspur Cafe bakes 120 muffins for the counter, and the head baker sets aside 5 more for the staff room. The cafe repeated exactly that routine on each of the 9 days of the town festival. Over the festival 348 of those muffins went stale and were thrown out. A neighbouring bakery then sent over 49 muffins to help with the final rush. The cafe prints its prices in dollars rather than in cents. Before opening on the first day it had handed out a dozen free samples that were never counted in the baking records. How many muffins did the cafe have at the end of the festival?

Nora seals 141 pencils into every box at the depot. Each carton holds 3 of those boxes, every pallet holds 4 cartons, and each truck is loaded with 4 pallets. Before a truck leaves, Felix always tosses in 52 loose pencils as spares, so his trucks carry more than Nora's boxes alone account for. On Friday 8 identical trucks left the depot, each one loaded and topped up in exactly that way. The depot's roof was repaired 6 years ago. How many pencils left the depot on Friday?
